more_pages: There is another page: run the same command with --next {handle}
fetched_page: The page opens without signing in.
fetched_signed: The page opens with the sign-in.
recognised: This looks like {software}. Using its API at {base}.
template_unconfirmed: Using the {software} template at {base} as asked; its API did not answer there yet.
found_description: a link to its API description
asked_schema: Asked the GraphQL API at {url} what it offers.
described: Read its API description at {url}: {reads} reads, {changes} changes noted.
needs_record: itda could not read the page on its own ({why}). itda can open your browser and watch as you use the site instead.
blocked_cloudflare: {host} is behind Cloudflare and refused itda.
blocked_bot_manager: {host} runs a bot manager that refused itda.
blocked_captcha: {host} asks for a captcha before it shows the page.
blocked_fix: itda could not read the page that way. Try the site's official API or ask the owner.
transport_invalid: ITDA_TRANSPORT is set to {value}, which itda does not know.
transport_fix: Set ITDA_TRANSPORT to auto or http, or leave it unset.
rate_limited_wait: {host} limits how often it is read and asked itda to wait {n} s.
rate_limited: {host} limits how often it is read and refused itda for now.
redirect_signin: {host} sends itda to a sign-in page instead of showing {path}.
redirect_signin_fix: Pages behind a sign-in: record yourself using them with `itda record`, or `itda setup` and answer yes to recording.
rate_limited_fix: Try again after the wait, or use the site's official API.
ask_record_anyway: Does the site need a sign-in to be useful? Record in the browser instead of fetching the page. [y/N]
no_record_allowed: itda could not read the page; --no-record forbids the browser.
watching: Opening your browser on {host} to watch what the page loads by itself. itda does not click or type; the window closes on its own.
watched: Watched the page load: {n} calls, {k} reads drafted.
watched_nothing: Watched the page load: {n} calls, nothing to draft.
watch_only_stop: Watching the page load was not enough ({why}), and --watch-only skips recording. Run again without it to record yourself using the site.
no_terminal: This needs a terminal to ask you questions; pass --no-record, --watch-only or --record, with --client and --yes, to run without one.
actions_heading: What agents will be able to do:
exists: '{site}' is already set up. Replace it? [y/N]
exists_kept: Kept the existing '{site}'. Run again with --yes, or a different --name, to replace it.
withheld: removed: {path}: the site does not give itda this page
skipped_refused: not tried: the site refused an earlier read; itda check tries it
why_mismatch: the answer was not what the page showed
why_wait: it asked to wait {n} s between requests
why_rate_limited: it limits how often it is read
later: Connect an agent any time with: itda mcp install claude-desktop (or cursor, vscode, codex, claude-code)
welcome: itda hands the websites you use to your AI agent. Paste the address of a site you use and press Enter. No address in mind? Type github, npm, crates-io or pypi. Enter alone shows the command list.
ask_client: Connect an agent? [1] Claude Desktop  [2] Claude Code  [3] Cursor  [4] VS Code  [5] Codex  [0] later:
restart_ask: {client} is open. Restart it now so itda shows up? [Y/n]
open_app: Open {client} and itda will be there.
done: Done. Ask your agent for something on '{site}', for example "{example}".
approve_note: A change runs only after you allow it here: itda approve <id>.
refresh_same: The sources draft the same actions; '{site}' stays as it is.
refresh_kept: Kept '{site}' as it is. Run again with --yes to write the changes.
ask_sign_in: Sign in to {host} here, with your user name and password? itda fills in the site's own sign-in form, as itself, and keeps the session sealed under the data directory. [Y/n]
ask_password: Password for {user} on {site} (sent once to the site's own sign-in form, never saved):
no_user_fix: Pass --user <name>, and the password as the first line of stdin.
no_password_fix: Type it after the question, or pipe it on stdin, for example from your password manager.
session_kept: Kept the session as {site}/{account}, sealed under the data directory with a key in the system keyring. Agents only see the account id; when it expires, `itda login {site}` signs in again.
session_saved: Signed in. itda sealed the session for {site}/{account} ({n} cookies) under the data directory with a key in the system keyring; agents only see the account id.
cookie_missing: {site} accepted the sign-in, but the {name} cookie its definition names did not appear
cookie_missing_fix: Check value_from in the definition's auth entry, or remove it.
query_missing: {site} accepted the sign-in, but did not hand out the {name} query parameter its definition names
query_missing_fix: Check value_from in the definition's auth entry; the key must appear in the sign-in's redirect or on the links of the first page after it.
session_saved_query: Signed in. itda sealed the {name} session value for {site}/{account} under the data directory with a key in the system keyring. It goes on the address of each request to the site; agents only see the account id.
nothing_works: No read worked; itda kept nothing. Try `itda record {url}` and use the site while it watches.
outcome_landed: The site did not answer, but {read} shows the change landed. It is in; do not ask for it again.
outcome_not_found: The site did not answer, and {read} does not show the change. If you still want it, ask for it again and review the new approval; itda never resends on its own.
outcome_unknown: The site did not answer, and the confirming read {read} failed too ({error}). Check the site before asking for the change again.
lost_answers: {n} change(s) whose answer was lost after sending:
lost_unchecked: no confirming read; check the site
sends_file: sends the file at {input}; you approve it by name, size and hash
confirms: after a lost answer: checks {read} for the new {input}
spec_valid: {file}: a valid definition of {site} ({n} actions). itda add {file} installs it.
spec_invalid: {file}: {n} problems; itda would not install it.
